sources.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
sources.title_en: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
sources.title_original: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI and Cisco推出开源运行时Shirudo，帮助团队在打补丁期间保护运行中的Linux系统；受控测试中，Codex生成的shield无需重启便挡住了针对Elasticsearch的Java4Shell攻击。

en.reason: OpenAI and Cisco's open-source Shirudo runtime lets teams keep running Linux systems protected while patches roll out, and in controlled tests a Codex-generated shield blocked a Java4Shell attack on Elasticsearch without a reboot.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Ai2发布RoboTrack基准与数据套件，含307个来自DROID等的人工标注视频，显示领先tracker在真实操作场景得分远低于既有基准，并推出在5项评测中4项达SOTA的RoboTracker-Warp。

sources.title: 密钥扫描减少 Slack 的误报 / Secret scanning reduces false positives for Slack
sources.title_zh: 密钥扫描减少 Slack 的误报
sources.title_en: Secret scanning reduces false positives for Slack
sources.title_original: Secret scanning reduces false positives for Slack
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 的 secret scanning 现已针对 Slack 密钥降低误报检测，其中 slack_incoming_webhook_url 检测器通过排除特定 URL 来减少误匹配，帮助开发者减少无效告警干扰。

en.reason: GitHub’s secret scanning now cuts false-positive detections for Slack secrets, with its slack_incoming_webhook_url detector excluding certain URLs to reduce mismatches and spare developers unnecessary invalid alerts.

en.title: OpenAI teams up with Cisco to open-source Shirudo, giving AI agent systems a "round-the-clock bulletproof vest

sources.title: Mira Murati 团队把模型“想三遍再说话”开源了：26.4B 循环 Transformer 登顶 Hugging Face，笔记本就能跑
sources.title_zh: Mira Murati 团队把模型“想三遍再说话”开源了：26.4B 循环 Transformer 登顶 Hugging Face，笔记本就能跑
sources.title_original: Mira Murati 团队把模型“想三遍再说话”开源了：26.4B 循环 Transformer 登顶 Hugging Face，笔记本就能跑
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Mira Murati 的 Thinking Machines Lab 开源模型仅 26.4B 的 Inkling2Mini，循环 Transformer 让中间 12 层对每个 token 跑三次，做到想三遍再说话，笔记本可跑，ARC-AGI-2 上以每任务 0.14 美元拿到 49.3%。

en.title: Mira Murati’s team open-sources a model that thinks three times before speaking: the 26.4B recurrent Transformer tops Hugging Face and runs on a laptop
en.reason: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab released the 26.4B open-weight Inkling2Mini, whose looped Transformer runs its middle 12 layers three times per token, scores 49.3% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.14 per task, and runs on a laptop.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Z.ai 将 750B 参数的 GLM-5.4 改为 28 层跑两次的 loop 架构，号称匹敌 2 至 3 万亿参数模型，但基准仅来自 30B 测试模型，并定位 Generalized Coding。

stories.title: 谷歌发现，技术债务会通过“智能体分心”导致编码智能体偏离正轨

sources.title: 谷歌发现，技术债务会通过“智能体分心”导致编码智能体偏离正轨
sources.title_zh: 谷歌发现，技术债务会通过“智能体分心”导致编码智能体偏离正轨
sources.title_original: 谷歌发现，技术债务会通过“智能体分心”导致编码智能体偏离正轨
sources.summary:
在最近的一篇文章中，谷歌高级软件工程师 Sam Saccone 和高级数据科学家 Madhuri Garikapati 指出了智能体分心的代价：AI 编码智能体会因陈旧的技术债务而偏离正轨，从而开始执行用户没有要求的“支线任务”。
在最近的一篇文章中，谷歌高级软件工程师 Sam Saccone 和高级数据科学家 Madhuri Garikapati 指出了智能体分心的代价：AI 编码智能体会因陈旧的技术债务而偏离正轨，从而开始执行用户没有要求的“支线任务”。
本文字数：1294 字
阅读完需：约 4 分钟
智能体易受代码库中陈旧 TODO/FIXME 注释误导，引发非预期的“支线任务”，导致逻辑错误或资源浪费。谷歌通过分析数亿次操作发现：13% 的会话含此类注释，其中 6% 触发绕道行为，41% 针对已关闭工单。
技术债务在 LLM 上下文感知时代成为主动干扰源，而非静态遗留问题；TODO 注释状态与提示词意图错配是典型分心诱因；大规模跟踪数据可量化智能体因文档过时导致的范围蔓延。

en.title: Google finds technical debt derails coding agents through "agent distraction
en.summary:
In a recent article, Google senior software engineer Sam Saccone and senior data scientist Madhuri Garikapati highlight the cost of agent distraction: AI coding agents get knocked off course by stale technical debt and begin taking on “side quests” users never asked for.

1,294 words · About 4 min read

Agents are easily misled by stale TODO/FIXME comments in the codebase, triggering unintended “side quests” that lead to logic errors or wasted resources. After analyzing hundreds of millions of operations, Google found that 13% of sessions contained such comments; of those, 6% triggered detours, and 41% involved tickets that had already been closed.

In the era of LLM context awareness, technical debt has become an active source of interference rather than a static legacy problem; mismatches between the status of TODO comments and prompt intent are a typical distraction trigger; large-scale trace data can quantify scope creep caused by outdated documentation.

Suitable for AI engineers, LLM application architects, and engineering productivity engineers.
en.reason: Google's analysis of hundreds of millions of agent operations found 13% of sessions derailed by stale TODO/FIXME comments, 6% triggering unsolicited detours and 41% involving already-closed tickets, plus a scanner agent built to clean outdated references.

en.title: The Next Stop for Data Analytics: Agentic Analytics
en.summary:
The next stop for data analytics: agentic analytics

Traditional data analytics systems were designed mainly for human users, relying on them to supply context and ask questions one at a time. AI Agents work differently: they can loop through queries, call tools, and act on the results. Humans, meanwhile, still frame the questions, apply expert judgment, and decide what information actually matters. This session will introduce agentic analytics as the direction data analytics is evolving in, explore how humans and AI Agents work together, where that collaboration breaks down without governed context and controls suited to running Agents at scale, and the four key platform capabilities needed to bring agentic analytics to enterprise-grade standards.
en.reason: Agentic analytics, where AI agents loop through queries and tool calls while humans frame questions and judge results, is examined alongside the governance and control gaps that block such collaboration, plus four platform capabilities needed for enterprise-scale deployment.

en.title: The Next Stop for Data Analytics: Agentic Analytics
en.summary:
The next stop for data analytics: agentic analytics

Traditional data analytics systems were designed mainly for human users, relying on them to supply context and ask questions one at a time. AI Agents work differently: they can loop through queries, call tools, and act on the results. Humans, meanwhile, still frame the questions, apply expert judgment, and decide what information actually matters. This session will introduce agentic analytics as the direction data analytics is evolving in, explore how humans and AI Agents work together, where that collaboration breaks down without governed context and controls suited to running Agents at scale, and the four key platform capabilities needed to bring agentic analytics to enterprise-grade standards.
en.reason: Agentic analytics, where AI agents loop through queries and tool calls while humans frame questions and judge results, is examined alongside the governance and control gaps that block such collaboration, plus four platform capabilities needed for enterprise-scale deployment.

sources.summary:
在re:Invent见证云和AI的下一次革命
在re:Invent见证云和AI的下一次革命
本文字数：5899 字
阅读完需：约 19 分钟
“如果 Agent 能比我更快地写代码，那我还有什么价值？我的编程技能还有意义吗？我对云计算的理解呢？”
即使是亚马逊云科技首席开发者布道师 Darko Mesaroš，也曾因 AI 编程能力的快速进步而陷入身份危机。今年 11 月，在“What If Lab｜万一实验室 AI 硬件创意黑客松”上，Darko 坦诚地分享了这段自我怀疑的经历。
回顾职业生涯，他发现，自己已经经历过一次类似的冲击。
云计算兴起之前，Darko 是一名系统管理员，与网络、数据库和存储管理员分工协作。随着云计算普及，基础设施逐渐被抽象为云服务，他也不得不掌握更广泛的技术能力。
“突然之间，我不能只懂得如何管理系统了。我必须了解所有这些事情，因为一切都被抽象化了。”
二十年前，云计算改变了工程师构建和运行软件的方式。如今，AI 正在接手越来越多的编程和工程任务。开发者需要再次思考，自己的工作将如何改变。
这两轮技术变革，都与亚马逊云科技密切相关。而 re:Invent 大

en.title: When AI changes everything, what do we build next?
en.summary:
Witnessing the next revolution in cloud and AI at re:Invent
Witnessing the next revolution in cloud and AI at re:Invent
Word count: 5,899
Reading time: about 19 minutes
"If an Agent can write code faster than I can, what am I worth? Do my programming skills still matter? What about my understanding of cloud computing?"
Even Darko Mesaroš, chief developer advocate at Amazon Web Services, once fell into an identity crisis over the rapid progress of AI coding capabilities. In November, at the "What If Lab | AI Hardware Creative Hackathon," Darko candidly shared this experience of self-doubt.
Looking back on his career, he realized he had already been through a similar shock once before.
Before the rise of cloud computing, Darko was a system administrator, working alongside network, database, and storage administrators. As cloud computing spread, infrastructure was gradually abstracted into cloud services, and he had to master a broader set of technical skills.
"Suddenly, I couldn't just know how to manage systems. I had to understand all these things, because everything was abstracted."
Twenty years ago, cloud computing changed how engineers build and run software. Today, AI is taking over more and more programming and engineering tasks. Developers need to think again about how their work will change.
Both waves of technological change are closely tied to Amazon Web Services. And re:Invent
en.reason: Amazon Web Services principal developer advocate Darko Mesaroš recounts an AI-driven identity crisis, with Lambda, SageMaker and Graviton re:Invent launches framing the 15th conference’s five keynotes and Security Day’s 70-plus sessions on agents in enterprise production.

sources.title_original: 超越试点：销售管理者的 AI 转型行动指南
sources.summary:
超越试点：销售管理者的 AI 转型行动指南AI 能够提升销售人员的工作效率、加快销售机会的成交速度，并扩大客户覆盖范围。然而，许多企业仍难以跨越试点阶段，真正实现 AI 的规模化应用。阻碍往往不只是技术本身。数据分散、工具繁多、职责归属不清，以及围绕现有部门壁垒构建的工作流程，都可能限制 AI 的实际应用。本场分享将为销售领导者提供一套切实可行的行动指南，探讨如何识别值得优先解决的业务问题、夯实数据基础、建立用户体验治理机制，并重新设计工作流程。了解如何在不盲目追逐每一个新模型的情况下，持续推进 AI 项目，并通过有效的变革管理，将 AI 试点探索转化为持久的销售业务成效。

en.title: Beyond the Pilot: A Sales Leader's Action Guide to AI Transformation
en.summary:
Beyond the Pilot: An Action Guide for Sales Leaders Driving AI Transformation

AI can boost sales productivity, accelerate deal cycles, and expand customer coverage. Yet many organizations still struggle to move past the pilot stage and achieve AI at scale. The obstacles often aren't just technical. Fragmented data, tool sprawl, unclear ownership, and workflows built around existing departmental silos can all limit real-world AI adoption. This session offers sales leaders a practical action guide, exploring how to identify the business problems worth prioritizing, strengthen the data foundation, establish user experience governance, and redesign workflows. Learn how to keep AI initiatives moving forward without chasing every new model, and how to use effective change management to turn pilot explorations into lasting sales results.
en.reason: Many enterprises stall at the AI pilot stage because of fragmented data, tool sprawl, unclear ownership and department silos, and this sales leader guide lays out a practical path: picking priority business problems, strengthening the data foundation, setting up governance and redesigning workflows.

stories.title: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055

sources.title: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055
sources.title_zh: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055
sources.title_original: AI音乐周刊 W.A 055
sources.summary: AI 做音乐正从“生成一首歌”走向完整创作流程，但发布和变现的规则也在收紧。这期《AI 音乐周刊》汇总了 Suno 歌曲转视频、在 AI 助手里直接做歌，以及用对话修改音效、配乐等更新，同时梳理平台对冒名作品、刷量与训练授权的新动向。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: SoundCloud 11月17日新增AI Abuse四类违规，禁止用AI刷量、假充真人并追回分成；本期还收录Spotify、Suno等更新。

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 055
en.summary: AI music is moving from "generate a song" toward the full creative workflow, but the rules for releasing and monetizing are tightening too. This edition of AI Music Weekly rounds up Suno's song-to-video feature, making tracks directly inside AI assistants, and updates for editing sound effects and scores through conversation, plus a look at platforms' new moves on impersonation, fake streams, and training licensing.
en.reason: SoundCloud added four AI Abuse violation categories on November 17, barring AI-driven stream manipulation and fake human personas while clawing back payouts, alongside Spotify's artist protection tool and Suno's Visuals, Platinum tier and MCP rollout.

sources.summary: 同样打开 Google AI Pro 订阅页，为什么有人能看到首年 99.99 美元，有人仍是原价？老金分享了自己获得黑五优惠的操作经历，从原有订阅处理、月付转年付，到退款、权益核验和关闭自动续费，都配了截图。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章讲Gemini Pro黑五首年99.99美元可用Gemini 4 Neon，并提醒Jio占Google One订阅位需先删除、再开4.99美元月付刷新包年页。

en.title: Gemini Pro is 50% off for Black Friday: $99.99 for a full year
en.summary: Why can some people see $99.99 for the first year on the same Google AI Pro subscription page while others still see the full price? Lao Jin shares how he secured the Black Friday deal, with screenshots covering everything from handling an existing subscription and switching from monthly to annual billing to refunds, verifying benefits, and turning off auto-renewal.
en.reason: Google's Black Friday deal gives Gemini Pro at $99.99 for the first year with access to Gemini 4 Neon, launched November 18, though Jio users must first remove the Google One subscription slot it occupies.

en.title: One person managing 18 AI assistants—and they all bottlenecked at the waiting-for-my-review stage.
en.summary: One person running 18 AI assistants ended up with 149 deliverables stuck in "waiting for me to look at them." Yuanzi uses their own one-person operation to work through a real dilemma: the faster AI produces output, the more human review and decision-making become the bottleneck. A useful reference for independent creators and small teams on cutting out pointless confirmations and saving limited energy for the calls that truly need to be made by you.
en.reason: A solo operator running 18 AI assistants hit 149 results awaiting confirmation, and this piece compares that bottleneck with McKinsey's claim that 2 to 5 people can oversee 50 to 100 agents.

sources.summary: 员工用 AI 越来越快，项目却还在等审批、等交接，省下的时间又变成了更多材料和会议。这篇沿着“个人助手→办公交付→团队协作”的演进，拆解了一个现实问题：每个人都有 AI，为什么团队仍然忙乱？
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 从OpenClaw 60天GitHub星标破25万，到WorkBuddy截至7月月活658.2万、阿里与字节重组办公Agent，文章追问单点效率为何难成业务突破，并指向企业级Agent OS。

en.title: From Everyone Raising Shrimp to AI Coworkers: Revelations from the 2026 AI Agent Evolution
en.summary: Employees are adopting AI faster and faster, yet projects still sit waiting on approvals and handoffs — and the time saved turns into more documents and more meetings. Tracing the shift from personal assistant to office deliverables to team collaboration, this piece unpacks a real-world question: if everyone has AI, why are teams still so busy?
en.reason: OpenClaw's 250,000 GitHub stars in 60 days, WorkBuddy's 6.582 million July MAU and Alibaba-ByteDance office-agent reshuffles frame AI agents' shift from personal assistant through office delivery to team collaboration, asking why individual speedups fail without an enterprise Agent OS.

sources.title: 用 T3 Code 组建多模型智能体团队
sources.title_zh: 用 T3 Code 组建多模型智能体团队
sources.title_original: 用 T3 Code 组建多模型智能体团队
sources.summary: Claude、Codex、Gemini 都用上了，结果自己却成了在窗口间搬运需求和代码的“传话员”？作者用T3 Code把多个模型组织成一支开发团队，从安装配置讲到任务交接、权限管理和跨模型审查，附有可复用的团队规则与角色提示词。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇指南把 Theo 在 11 月 9 日至 18 日三款前沿模型发布后组建的团队，展开成 T3 Code 六步搭建流程，并加入 Grok Bot 实现离线派发任务。

en.title: Build a multi-model agent team with T3 Code
en.summary: Using Claude, Codex, and Gemini but still stuck as a middleman shuttling requirements and code between windows? The author uses T3 Code to turn multiple models into a development team, covering setup and configuration, task handoff, permission management, and cross-model review, with reusable team rules and role prompts.
en.reason: T3 Code, a local control layer that launches Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok Build agents, is set out in a six-step setup guide that adds a Grok Bot for dispatching tasks while offline, expanding on Theo's team built after three frontier models shipped between November 9 and 18.

sources.title_original: 1/7 AI agents don’t browse your product in a straight line. They teleport. Docs, CLI, API, MCP server, browser no shared ID, no session, no trail. Until now. To your product, it looks like a handful of unrelated visitor…
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章指出 AI agents 不按直线浏览，而会在 Docs、CLI、API、MCP server、browser 间“瞬移”，没有共享 ID、session 或 trail，产品端只看到几个互不相关的访客，并发布论文 Following the Agent 讨论如何重建这一过程。

en.reason: AI agents jump between Docs, CLI, API, MCP server and browser with no shared ID, session or trail, so a product sees only unrelated visitors, and the paper "Following the Agent" addresses reconstructing that fragmented path.

en.title: New trends in enterprise AI: driving AI Agents into a new phase of large-scale adoption
en.reason: Enterprise AI is shifting from task-level efficiency tools to autonomous AI Agents that run complex workflows continuously, and Snowflake's unified platform is presented as the answer to missing business context, weak governance, rising costs and fragmented ecosystems that block scale.
